title: SSX
shortDescription: PS2 launch title that founded the EA Sports BIG brand with over-the-top snowboarding tricks and neon courses.
historicalSignificance: Showcased early PS2 hardware power and established extreme sports arcade gaming in the new millennium.

sourceReferences: Video Game History Foundation Preservation Archive
